description: Edit a message the bot sent: text, embeds, link buttons, files (replaces the attachments when given).

bot.description: Use this bot (name or id) instead of choosing automatically

channel.description: Channel or thread name, id, or message link

dry_run.description: Show the requests that would be made without changing anything

color.description: Hex like "#57F287", a name like "green", or a number

image.description: Big image: a URL, or "attachment://file.png" for a file sent with the message

thumbnail.description: Small image on the right: URL or "attachment://file.png"

timestamp.description: true for now, or an ISO date

name.description: File name in Discord (use it in attachment://name)

source.description: Local file path or http(s) URL

server.description: Server name or id. Optional when the bot is in one server or DISCORD_GUILD_ID is set.

name: edit_message
